SELECT * FROM sale_off SO INNER JOIN visit_history VHC ON SO.cstmr_id=VHC.cstmr_id AND SO.datetime=VHC.datetime WHERE SO.cstmr_id=#{cstmrId} GROUP BY sale_id ORDER BY SO.datetime asc;

SELECT Y.oldPrc + Y.newPrc totalPrc ,Y.visitCnt FROM( select count(sale_id) visitCnt ,(select IFNULL(sum(pay_card + pay_cash),0)*100 from sale_off where cstmr_id = #{cstmrId} AND is_old=1) oldPrc ,(select IFNULL(sum(pay_card + pay_cash),0) from sale_off where cstmr_id = #{cstmrId} AND is_old=0) newPrc from sale_off S where cstmr_id = ${cstmrId} )Y
